b0289-heading-01.machineText: 檢查簽署狀態（原生工具）

b0290-text-01.machineText: `wails3 signing` 用於設定簽署憑證。若要檢查簽署狀態，請直接使用原生工具：
b0290-text-01.sourcePreview: `wails3 signing` configures signing credentials. To inspect signing state, use the native tooling di…

b0293-cell-01.machineText: 列出 macOS 程式碼簽署身分

b0297-cell-01.machineText: 檢查 PGP 金鑰檔案

b0306-text-01.machineText: 確認憑證已安裝至「鑰匙圈」
b0306-text-01.sourcePreview: Ensure your certificate is installed in the Keychain

b0307-text-01.machineText: 使用`security find-identity -v -p codesigning`檢查憑證是否尚未過期
b0307-text-01.sourcePreview: Check it hasn't expired with `security find-identity -v -p codesigning`

b0308-text-01.machineText: 確認您擁有「Developer ID Application」憑證（而不只是「Apple Development」憑證）
b0308-text-01.sourcePreview: Make sure you have a "Developer ID Application" certificate (not just "Apple Development")

b0310-text-01.machineText: 檢查公證記錄：`xcrun notarytool log <submission-id> --keychain-profile <profile>`
b0310-text-01.sourcePreview: Check the notarization log: `xcrun notarytool log <submission-id> --keychain-profile <profile>`

b0311-text-01.machineText: 確認已啟用強化執行階段

b0312-text-01.machineText: 確認應用程式未包含未簽署的二進位檔
b0312-text-01.sourcePreview: Verify your app doesn't include unsigned binaries

b0314-text-01.machineText: 確認鑰匙圈已解鎖：`security unlock-keychain`
b0314-text-01.sourcePreview: Make sure the keychain is unlocked: `security unlock-keychain`

b0315-text-01.machineText: 檢查應用程式套件組合的檔案權限
b0315-text-01.sourcePreview: Check file permissions on the app bundle

b0318-text-01.sourcePreview: Verify the certificate path is correct

b0320-text-01.machineText: 確認憑證有效（未過期或遭撤銷）
b0320-text-01.sourcePreview: Ensure the certificate is valid (not expired or revoked)

b0322-text-01.machineText: 請嘗試其他時間戳記伺服器：

b0328-text-01.machineText: 確認金鑰檔案採用 ASCII 裝甲格式
b0328-text-01.sourcePreview: Ensure the key file is in ASCII-armored format

b0329-text-01.machineText: 使用`gpg --show-keys <key.asc>`檢查金鑰是否尚未過期
b0329-text-01.sourcePreview: Check the key hasn't expired with `gpg --show-keys <key.asc>`

b0332-text-01.machineText: 確認已正確匯入公開金鑰
b0332-text-01.sourcePreview: Ensure the public key is properly imported

b0333-text-01.machineText: 檢查套件在簽署後是否未遭修改
b0333-text-01.sourcePreview: Check that the package wasn't modified after signing

fm-description.sourcePreview: Guide for signing your Wails applications on all platforms
